# Compitiello & Donofrio Private Investigations (CAD PI)

> Discreet, trustworthy, and elite private investigation services led by former federal law enforcement supervisory special agents. Daily field operations centered in Maricopa County, with statewide Arizona coverage and nationwide federal network capabilities.

## Agency Overview
Compitiello & Donofrio Private Investigations (CAD PI) is an Arizona-licensed and bonded private investigative agency headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. The agency is founded and led by Michael Compitiello, a former Supervisory Special Agent with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security / Homeland Security Investigations (DHS/HSI) with over 25 years of federal law enforcement leadership and 35+ years of combined investigative experience.

- **Headquarters**: 6991 E Camelback Rd. STE D-300, Scottsdale, AZ 85251
- **Phone**: (480) 630-2533
- **Email**: johnd@cadprivateinvestigations.com
- **Website**: https://cadprivateinvestigations.com
- **Privacy Policy & Terms**: https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/privacy-policy.html
- **Licensing**: Licensed & Bonded Private Investigative Agency (State of Arizona)

## Core Investigative Services
- **Financial Investigations**: Forensic tracing of corporate and private funds, uncovering fraud, hidden assets, embezzlement, and complex financial schemes.
- **Asset Tracing & Recovery**: Locating hidden holdings, real estate, offshore accounts, and corporate structures to support litigation, asset division, or debt recovery.
- **Corporate Vetting & Due Diligence**: Deep background profiling of business entities, potential partners, executives, and vendors to mitigate corporate liability.
- **Physical & Digital Surveillance**: Discreet, high-definition surveillance for family law, infidelity verification, insurance defense, and court proceedings.
- **Missing Persons & Witness Locates**: Locating estranged relatives, runways, missing persons, debtors, or critical trial witnesses using national database queries and field tracing.
- **Immigration Compliance & Vetting**: File verification, visa vetting, and immigration compliance backed by over 30 years of federal immigration oversight experience.
- **Human Trafficking Investigations**: Specialized evidence collection and rescue coordination leveraging direct federal task-force leadership experience.
- **Cyber Security & Digital Forensics**: Computer forensics, data breach analysis, and personal identifiable information (PII) security.

## Target Audience
- **Attorneys & Law Firms**: Family law, criminal defense, civil litigation, and corporate counsel requiring court-admissible evidence and expert witness testimony.
- **Corporations & Businesses**: Executive leadership, HR departments, and risk managers seeking due diligence, fraud investigation, and internal theft resolution.
- **High-Net-Worth Individuals & Families**: Private clients seeking confidential background vetting, domestic investigations, infidelity inquiries, or missing person location.
- **Insurance Companies & Adjusters**: Special investigations units (SIU) and defense counsel investigating fraudulent claims and liability disputes.

## Operational Geographic Coverage
- **Primary Field Operations**: Maricopa County (Scottsdale, Phoenix, Mesa, Tempe, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Peoria).
- **Statewide Arizona**: Full investigative reach across Tucson, Flagstaff, Yuma, Prescott, Pima County, and Pinal County.
- **National & Federal Network**: Nationwide case deployment and federal litigation support through established federal law enforcement partnerships.

## Leadership & Credentials
- **Michael Compitiello**: Founder & Director. Former DHS/HSI Supervisory Special Agent (26 years), Air Rescue Squadron Veteran (U.S. Air Force), Recipient of the HSI Director's Award for Excellence in Investigations and INS Commissioner's Award.
- **John Donofrio**: Private Investigator & Operations Manager.

## Investigative Dispatches & Field Insights (Blog)
CAD PI publishes authoritative investigative briefings, statutory analyses, and case methodologies authored by former federal supervisory special agents:
- **Tracing Hidden Assets & Offshore Corporate Shells in High-Stakes Disputes** (Author: Michael Compitiello): Analysis of domestic privacy LLCs (Wyoming, Delaware, Nevada), offshore trusts, source-and-application audits, and correspondent banking SWIFT tracing.
- **Arizona Surveillance Law: Evidentiary Admissibility in Maricopa County Courts** (Author: John Donofrio): Examination of A.R.S. § 13-3005 (one-party consent), A.R.S. § 13-3019 (reasonable expectation of privacy), and A.R.S. § 13-2923 (GPS vehicle tracking rules in Arizona).
- **Red Flags in Corporate Mergers: Vetting Beneficial Ownership Beyond the Balance Sheet** (Author: Michael Compitiello): Pre-transaction due diligence uncovering jurisdictional charter migration, circular related-party vendor payments, and unindexed county court records.
- **Uncovering Insider Data Exfiltration: Digital Forensics in Corporate Trade Secret Theft** (Authors: Alex Nader & Scott Unger): Forensic extraction of Windows USB registry hives, LNK shortcuts, and Shellbags artifacts to secure emergency Temporary Restraining Orders (TROs).
- **Blog Archive**: https://cadprivateinvestigations.com/blog.html
